author: Director
question: Does bounded pretranslation repartition improve accepted-text ownership across distinct meeting speaker groups without increasing severe ownership errors, losing text, or violating Audio lifecycle and deadline rules?
claim_population: Available English AMI Mix-Headset meetings with Deepgram Nova-3 English streaming and the pinned continuous Sortformer F16 producer. No target-device conversation, language-general, model-pretraining-unseen or production-wide guarantee.

hypotheses.primary: R2 reduces equal-speaker-cluster-weighted cross-speaker accepted-text contamination compared with R0 on sequential transitions.
hypotheses.safety: R2 does not introduce severe wrong ownership, text loss or duplication in predefined guards; uncertainty and fragmentation remain visible costs.
hypotheses.mechanism: Benefits require a confirmed event received before actual translation-unit admission, not retrospective access to unavailable evidence.

providers.asr: Deepgram Nova-3 English streaming, mono linear16 at 16kHz; native diarization and paid add-ons disabled; local ASR prohibited without subsequent user approval
providers.translation: google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it via existing OpenRouter adapter, en to ko; same pinned prompt and route for both arms
providers.translation_context: Fixed empty context and no scene participant count for both arms on every parent; no evolving translation-history context in this experiment
providers.speaker: Existing continuous native Sortformer 4spk v2.1 F16, threshold 0.5, confirmation 1600 source samples, no model training

arms.R0: Existing real C5-sealed Audio path with no PSEM intervention
arms.R2: Same PCM and accepted Deepgram text as R0. At actual translation admission, partition only on valid confirmed local transitions using genuine provider timing; preserve one sealed parent and separate ownership children. Unknown or overlapping support never force-assigns a speaker.
arms.R1_diagnostic: Prospective C13 requests on the same frozen accepted-text record; actionability diagnostic only, not a claim of actual changed-PCM recognition or translation effect.
arms.correct_transition_control: Annotation-correct local transitions charged at the actual receipt of the first causally covering producer chunk; same application cutoff; unreachable hindsight is never counted.

policy_selection: R2 is the single confirmatory candidate. DEV may repair implementation defects and establish timing/provenance validity, but may not sweep model thresholds or wait durations. If R2 cannot pass DEV safety or the correct-transition control shows no relevant headroom, stop before HOLDOUT and report the failure. A new hybrid or alternative policy requires a named Director revision before any HOLDOUT outcomes are inspected.

development.regime: Full available continuous recordings through the actual C5 Audio controller and Deepgram adapter. Historical Soniox captures are reference only, not this provider DEV data.
development.source_history: Start each source at its genuine beginning with explicit initial unknown/reference state; do not reset PSEM at logical seals or reuse future history.

holdout.regime: Full continuous recording per speaker cluster, approximately 3.55 hours total; same pipeline and candidate as DEV
holdout.interpretation: All ten are held out from this policy development, but four are not historically untouched. Report the six-source subset separately. Sortformer pretraining contamination remains unknown.
holdout.lock: Hash audio, annotation versions, speaker-cluster membership, policy code/config and metric definitions before first HOLDOUT inference. No tuning, source replacement, outcome-based exclusion or optional stopping after unblinding. Budget or runtime truncation is an incomplete evaluation, not a smaller passing sample.

stratum_assignment: Annotation and lifecycle definitions fixed before model results. Natural strata retain full counts; synthetic gap, duplicate, cancellation and exact-deadline probes are reported separately and never inflate natural sample size.

measurements.unit: Accepted text with real timing/provenance. A lexical ownership scorer must distinguish reference labels from verified local segment boundaries and expose ambiguous annotation/ASR alignment.
measurements.primary: For each eligible cluster, proportion of attributable accepted lexical text incorrectly merged across a sequential speaker boundary; report R2 minus R0. Equal cluster weighting, not word-pooled pseudo-replication.
measurements.uncertainty: Paired cluster bootstrap 95% interval with 10000 resamples and seed 156; exact per-cluster deltas, eligible counts and leave-one-cluster-out sensitivity. If fewer than eight eligible clusters, the confirmatory result is inconclusive, not a relaxed pass.
measurements.coverage: Report all accepted text including unaligned, mixed and UNKNOWN. Provide worst-case bounds treating newly unassigned formerly attributable text as unresolved harm, not as an ownership correction.
measurements.conservation: Exact ordered reconstruction of normalized accepted text per immutable parent; missing and duplicate spans independently counted
measurements.fragmentation: Ownership children per parent, singleton fragments and extra splits on same-speaker guards
measurements.latency: Monotonic actual source support, producer completion, receipt, recognition terminal, partition, translation admission, dispatch and completion; p50/p95/max added partition/admission delay and actual C5 deadline violations
measurements.translation: OFF and R2 traverse the actual fixed translation adapter with the same request configuration. Source ownership is primary; do not claim semantic translation-quality improvement solely from more output children. Preserve outputs for blinded paired inspection under a fixed rubric and report subjective assessments separately.

confirmatory_decision.effect: Primary cluster-mean delta below zero with upper 95% interval below zero, improvement in at least 70 percent of eligible clusters, and benefit not explained solely by increased unassigned text; report absolute effect, not significance alone.
confirmatory_decision.safety: Zero missing/duplicate accepted text, zero mutation after admission or retired generation, and zero newly introduced severe guard errors. Severe means an unambiguously attributable lexical group newly assigned across a verified local speaker boundary or a previously safe same-speaker guard becoming cross-owner, not punctuation-only ambiguity.
confirmatory_decision.cost: No intentional PSEM wait or C5 extension. Every late operation is rejected and counted. Any gain purchased by uncertainty/fragmentation or measured admission delay is explicitly reported; a safety failure blocks adoption regardless of mean improvement.
possible_results: Supported only within declared AMI/provider scope
Inconclusive due to sample, timing, alignment, runtime or budget gap
confirmatory_decision.no_expansion_after_result: Failed or inconclusive HOLDOUT results do not authorize another tuned pass under the same confirmatory label.

budget.meter: Existing durable OpenRouter journal, including retries and translation children. Deepgram uses user-confirmed ample free credits and is excluded from cash-cap enforcement. Retain earlier Deepgram entries as informational history, not cash liabilities.
budget.settlement: For OpenRouter use reliable billed usage; otherwise retain the conservative reservation, including failed or in-flight requests.
budget.overage: Stop before an OpenRouter request exceeds its cash or phase cap. Do not switch ASR automatically. Deepgram usage does not trigger the budget stop.
budget.privacy: Public AMI audio and recognized text only. No personal audio or secret-bearing logs.
budget.readiness: OpenRouter request bounds remain enforced. No further precise Deepgram billing-bound investigation is required; execution readiness depends on actual Audio-path correctness.
budget.pricing_basis: Deepgram user-provided free credits; regular-rate estimates are informational only. OpenRouter fixed Gemma prompt/output bounds.
budget.allocation_revision: U7: OpenRouter-only DEV2.25/HOLDOUT2.25/contingency0.50, total USD5. Supersedes U6 combined-provider cap, not the sample, provider, policy, timing or evidence requirements.

execution_barriers: Implemented Audio path and budget gate with focused zero-cost tests and executable smoke
Director acceptance of measured billing bounds and DEV execution instructions
DEV completion, applicable evidence review and committed policy/config freeze
One locked HOLDOUT run and actual OFF/R2 translation comparison
Independent review, Director adjudication and bounded-scope final decision
